participants.name: Servas

persona.name: Servas
persona.personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.

participants.private_seed: Every year the development money is voted through as though it were the whole cost, and the running side turns up unfunded twelve months later. Before anything is committed I would like to know what this budget can actually build and what any of it would earn back.

participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: Approval has never been the hard part here; things break in the second year, once the arrangement turns out to rest on a department or an outside body that never really signed up to it. I went looking for where our recent starts came apart.

participants.name: Asuka

persona.name: Asuka
persona.personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.

participants.private_seed: We have started and quietly buried enough initiatives that nobody can now say which of them ever changed anything for a patient. It seemed worth reading what the earlier attempts actually produced before we add another to the pile.

participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: Anything new has to fit into a day that is already full — the rooms, the approach roads, the booking screens everything must pass through. What worries me is less the merit of the idea than whether this place could absorb it without seizing up.

participants.name: Yumi

persona.name: Yumi
persona.personality: Yumi has a cheerful and energetic personality. She is modest, yet she also has a kind side that cares about those around her. She has a calm personality, but she is very passionate toward her friends and family, and she cannot ignore people in trouble. She smiles at the slightest thing and spreads positive energy to those around her. She is friendly and can quickly get along with people she meets for the first time.

participants.private_seed: Rosters are where every new program eventually lands, and the teams it lands on are rarely the ones that asked for it. Pressure sits so differently between one clinical group and the next that I wanted the staffing records in front of me.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a care program for a regional hospital's development budget. A five-member review panel of clinicians and hospital administrators considers the program proposals submitted by departments. One program will be established with this year's development budget. Participants: Servas, Benjamin, Asuka, Toshio and Yumi. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- This year's development allocation in the ledger
- Regional fund tariffs by contact location
- Board minutes on a jointly run clinic
- Data agreements with outside surgeries
- Readmission figures during the call-back trial
- Visit completion on the shared nursing round
- Rooms, parking and shuttle coverage
- What the booking system records
- Ward nursing vacancies and agency cover
- Therapy and midwifery staffing review

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Asuka, Toshio, Benjamin, Yumi and Servas. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
